title: Team AI training in Kingman, AZ | Creosote Labs
meta_description: A one-day, hands-on AI workshop for teams in Kingman, Arizona, on their own tools and documents. $1,000 per person, 5-person minimum, travel included.
intro: Offices in Kingman generally already have an AI tool available through the software they pay for: Copilot inside Microsoft 365, Gemini inside Google Workspace, or Claude on its own. Medical and dental front desks, trucking and logistics offices, insurance agencies, real estate brokerages, and city and county departments produce a steady volume of letters, summaries, reports, and customer replies. Training applies where a team has the tool but has not worked out how to use it on those documents.

Creosote Labs delivers a one-day, hands-on workshop at the team's office in Kingman or remotely, in the AI tool the company already uses. Participants work on their own computers with their own documents, produce real work during the session, and document their own process. Each person leaves with a working setup and a written guide, and a 30-day follow-up session is included. The workshop is $1,000 per person for up to 10 people with a 5-person minimum, travel included; a program with 3 monthly follow-ups is $1,400 per person.
projects: A workshop for a medical billing office where each participant builds a prompt set for drafting claim appeal letters from their own denials.
A session for a trucking company's dispatch and safety staff on summarizing driver logs and incident reports in Copilot.
A day with a real estate brokerage's agents writing listing descriptions and client updates in Gemini from their own MLS data.
Training for an insurance agency on turning policy documents into plain-language renewal summaries for clients.
A workshop for a county department's administrative staff on drafting public notices and meeting summaries from their own templates.

faqs.q: Does the team need to buy an AI tool before the workshop?
faqs.a: Usually not, because the workshop runs in the tool the company already has, such as Copilot in Microsoft 365, Gemini in Google Workspace, or Claude. If nothing is in place, that is settled on the scheduling call.

faqs.q: What does each participant need to bring?
faqs.a: Each participant brings their own computer, a login to the AI tool, and a few real documents from their work, such as a report they write regularly, a customer email, or a template. The session produces finished versions of those.

faqs.q: What is the pricing for a team in Kingman?
faqs.a: Training is $1,000 per person for up to 10 people, with a 5-person minimum, and travel to Kingman is included. Teams larger than 10 receive a quote. The program that adds 3 monthly follow-up sessions is $1,400 per person.
